domains.scope: Create, save, reopen, relocate, media references and missing files
domains.static_mapping: Partial: RIFF/NUND container, bounded32-bit archive declarations/class/object identities, counted track hierarchy, active fixed-tempo flag/value, and linked AudioClip/Cluster/File/FNPath descriptors verified against original instructions and ten shipped templates. Unknown state retained. Shared counted-track tempo/signature pairs, fixed-clock arithmetic and branch-invariant origin meter are separately bounded by the new timing/signature evidence. One/two-point canonical source jump maps now bound through exact allowed metadata, default local lifecycle and native iterator/cache arithmetic; hosted registry/observer context remains unverified.
domains.application_implementation: Independent project/media bundle. Bounded CPR profile-v3 imports recover ordered empty audio tracks, shared native fixed clocks or one/two-point canonical jump maps, and concordant origin meter. Six pinned factory maps recover original period/anchor bits; four fixed results remain unchanged. V1/V2 interpreters and original CPR/report provenance are preserved. Active native descriptors must match exact source replay. Unknown source state remains unsupported; effective hosted clock equivalence is unverified.

domains.scope: Audio and project interchange, channel layouts, sample formats and metadata
domains.static_mapping: partial: native DAWproject parser/writer boundary values, unit enums and explicit interpolation emission traced. Host-side parameter conversion, tempo-time representation and runtime exchange remain unresolved.
domains.application_implementation: Mono/stereo audio import and stereo float32 WAV export. Strict DAWproject 1.0 audio subset with transactional import/export and referenced-media extraction. Unsupported routing/devices, musical anchors, ramps, missing interpolation and unrepresented automation reject. An active native clock requires explicit Use Rebase Timing conversion before exchange; it is never silently serialized as generic BPM math. Local roundtrips/XSD checks are not Cubase runtime interoperability. Bounded CPR profile-v2 import recovers ordered empty audio tracks, a verified shared fixed-tempo clock with native Float32 period and binary64 operation order, and a simple origin meter only when compact and typed records agree. Original bytes and versioned reports remain preserved; frozen v1 reports replay unchanged. Active native clocks must match the source-replayed report on load/save. Wrong interface roles use an explicit 120 BPM application default; unsupported native state never becomes playable content.

domains.scope: Start/stop/seek, locators, loop, punch and synchronization
domains.application_implementation: Playback, pause/stop/seek and musical-position display use the selected application tempo map or supported retained native fixed clock. Loop/punch/sync and target transport equivalence remain unimplemented or unverified. Supported CPR jump clocks now preserve direct source periods and native quantization; no runtime reference measurement.

domains.scope: Tempo maps, meter, sample positions, musical and linear time bases
domains.static_mapping: Partial: native fixed-mode value and exact Float32-period/binary64 clock operations verified with 480 native ticks per quarter; counted track interface pairs bind the supported shared clock. Compact and typed origin signatures are recoverable only when they agree under simple-state/variation gates. A native compatibility branch can discard typed signature data; its context remains unresolved. Variable-map and audio-event/AudioCluster bindings remain under investigation; no target runtime output or FPCR observed. APP005 additionally binds supported one/two-point serialized map periods/anchors, exact knot selection and canonical recurrence; arbitrary hosted context remains open.
domains.application_implementation: General application jump tempo/signature maps, anchors and snapping remain application policies. CPR fixed-v1 and jump-map-v1 clocks separately retain recovered native arithmetic with480ticks perquarter, bounded finite normal-or-zero domain and nearest rounding. Map records preserve direct binary32 periods; one/two kind0 records require positive-zero origin and exact canonical cached anchors. Default local lifecycle is bounded; replaceable host providers/observers remain unverified. More points, ramps and broader signature/display/stretch/swing semantics remain unresolved.
